meta.source_label_zh: HadCM3 模拟器 · 第 67 号成员
meta.note: NWS climate-emulation workflow, ensemble member 67. Sea level = the GSL input of the emulator (capped at +24 m). Bristol = site LB (52.5 N, 3.75 W) changes since today added to Met Office 1991-2020 Filton averages.
meta.what: annual-mean surface air temperature change from today (C), HadCM3 emulator, member 67

encoding: field(t) = mean + sum_k (coeffs[t,k] * cscale[k] / 32767) * (basis[k] * bscale[k] / 32767); mean float32, basis/coeffs int16
